name: Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe
description: During the Mandalorian Wars, Mandalore the Ultimate wielded a powerful battle-axe. Forged in the shape of a traditional mythosaur axe with metals taken from the Galactic Republic's prized capital ship, the Courageous, after the Mandalorian's victory in the Battle of Serroco, the battle-axe became a symbol of Mandalore's prowess. With a long pole staff and the addition of cortosis, as well as an energy cell, Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe was twice as deadly as those traditionally constructed from mythosaur bone.

data.name: Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe
data.material: Starship metals, cortosis, and an energy cell
